Information.draftNotice: This planning draft has not been legally reviewed or approved by the data provider. It is not final.
Information.aboutPurposeBody: What To Play Next is a working name for a game-discovery project. It helps people compare games using explicit criteria such as platform, genre, rating, release date, game mode, and play time.
Information.aboutMatchingBody: Search criteria are applied strictly. Missing provider data stays missing, and an empty result is not filled with approximate matches.
Information.aboutSourcesBody: Catalog details shown on this site are normalized from provider data so the same fields can be compared consistently.
Information.aboutSourceLanguageBody: Official titles and provider text are kept in their source language rather than automatically translated.
Information.privacyStatusBody: This page is a planning outline, not a final privacy policy. The product is not ready for public beta until this material has been reviewed and completed.
Information.privacyReviewBody: A reviewed policy still needs to document:
Information.privacyReviewProviders: service providers, the information they process, and why;
Information.privacyReviewRetention: retention periods for operational data and any analytics;
Information.privacyReviewTransfers: international data transfers and the safeguards that apply;
Information.privacyReviewAnalytics: analytics, cookies, consent, and related obligations;
Information.privacyReviewContact: a privacy contact and the process for exercising applicable rights.
Information.termsStatusBody: This page is a planning outline, not final terms of service. It intentionally does not set binding usage rules or legal terms.
Information.termsReviewBody: Reviewed terms still need decisions about:
Information.termsReviewUse: who may use the service and what use is acceptable;
Information.termsReviewContent: ownership and permitted use of product and provider content;
Information.termsReviewLiability: warranties, disclaimers, and limits of liability;
Information.termsReviewContact: applicable jurisdiction, notices, and a contact channel.

Landing.description: Combine platform, genre, rating, release date, game mode, and play time. Get strict results you can compare without guessing why they appeared.
Landing.principleVisibleDescription: Every applied criterion remains clear and removable.
Landing.principleMissingDescription: Unknown values are shown honestly, never invented.
Landing.principleZeroDescription: We suggest what to relax without sneaking in near matches.
